summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the exercise of share options by two insiders, Mr. Carl Erik Steen (Director) and Mr. Vidar Hasund (Contracted CFO), who exercised 75,000 and 100,000 share options respectively at a strike price of US$6.49 per share. The board resolved to issue 175,000 new shares upon payment of the strike price and compliance with Euronext Rule Book II. This is an insider equity incentive exercise, not a special situation event like a tender offer, acquisition, or restructuring. The filing reflects routine capital management and insider transactions.
